question: Birsa Munda hockey stadium is situated in _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium is located in Rourkela, Odisha.

• It is named after the tribal freedom fighter, Birsa Munda.

• This stadium is a significant venue for national and international hockey matches.

• Rourkela is also known as the "Steel City of Odisha" due to the presence of one of the largest steel plants in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Birsa Munda**

• Birsa Munda (1875-1900) was an Indian tribal freedom fighter, religious leader, and folk hero who belonged to the Munda tribe.

• He is considered one of the prominent leaders in the Indian independence movement against the British rule.

• He led the Munda Rebellion against the British government in the late 19th century.

• His contributions are especially significant in the regions of Jharkhand, Odisha, Bihar, and West Bengal.

• **Rourkela**

• Rourkela is a planned city located in the northern part of Odisha.

• It is known for the Rourkela Steel Plant, one of the largest steel plants in India.

• The city is also a major educational hub with institutions like the National Institute of Technology (NIT) Rourkela.

• Rourkela is well-connected by road, rail, and air, making it an important industrial and commercial center.

• **Hockey in Odisha**

• Odisha has a rich history and tradition in the sport of hockey.

• The state has produced several renowned hockey players who have represented India at international levels.

• The Odisha government has been actively promoting hockey through various initiatives, including the establishment of sports infrastructure and training facilities.

• Odisha hosted the Men's Hockey World Cup in 2018 at the Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar.
